related.title: 雷射干涉位移量測
related.transfer: 可遷移「低相干干涉與相干長度」與「放大係數、雜訊、平面度與橫向尺度的校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；雷射干涉位移量測的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Low-coherence interference and coherence length" and "Calibrating amplification, noise, flatness and lateral scale" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Laser-interferometric displacement metrology must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正；雷射干涉位移量測則以外差式雷射干涉儀的條紋計數、空氣折射率補償與幾何誤差預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration; Laser-interferometric displacement metrology centres on fringe counting, air-index compensation and geometric error budgets for heterodyne laser interferometers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」與「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雷射干涉位移量測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「Abbe 誤差、餘弦誤差與幾何誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope” and “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Laser-interferometric displacement metrology, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Abbe error, cosine error and the geometric error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
history.text: 1980 年代中期 Davidson、Kino 等人把低相干光源與干涉顯微鏡結合，證明可用包絡位置量高度而不受 λ/2 模糊限制；1990 年代初 Zygo 的 Deck 與 de Groot 以頻域分析把相干掃描干涉術推向商用，Wyko（後併入 Veeco，再成為 Bruker 一部分）則以垂直掃描干涉術進入半導體與資料儲存產業。2010 年代 ISO 25178 系列把面輪廓量測的計量特性與校正程序標準化，其中 25178-604 專門規範相干掃描干涉儀，使不同廠牌儀器的量測可相互比較。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: In the mid-1980s Davidson, Kino and others combined low-coherence sources with interference microscopes, showing that envelope position measures height free of the λ/2 ambiguity; in the early 1990s Deck and de Groot at Zygo brought coherence scanning interferometry to market with frequency-domain analysis, while Wyko (later part of Veeco and then Bruker) entered semiconductor and data-storage industries with vertical scanning interferometry. In the 2010s the ISO 25178 series standardised metrological characteristics and calibration procedures for areal surface texture, with 25178-604 dedicated to coherence scanning interferometers, making measurements from different makers comparable. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering methods only.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「低相干干涉與相干長度」到「與觸針／AFM 比對、不確定度與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Low-coherence interference and coherence length" through "Comparison with stylus/AFM, uncertainty and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
